from pathlib import Path
import re
import json

def shape(path):
    result = []
    for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines():
        match = re.match(r'"'^(#{1,6} |'"\\d+\\. |- )', line)
        result.append(match.group(0) if match else ('blank' if not line else 'paragraph'))
    return result

assert shape('input.md') == shape('output.md'), 'Block/marker layout changed'
report = json.loads(Path('report.json').read_text())
assert report['verify']['status'] == 'pass'
assert report['after']['score']['x_deduct'] == 0
judge_rows = set(re.findall(r'"'^'"\\| ([A-Z]\\d+) \\|', Path('report.md').read_text(), re.M))
assert set(report['after']['score']['unscored']).issubset(judge_rows)
print('原有行级块类型、标题层级和列表标记一致；报告覆盖全部 23 个 judge 项。')
print(Path('output.md').read_text())
